claimPolicy: This source-controlled file is a fail-closed policy baseline and must not be mutated to approve its own Git commit. Production approval is supplied as an external exact-commit attestation from a production environment whose protection and approval rules are separately verified. Every gate remains pending until its retained evidence is independently reviewed. Real patient data remains blocked until the separate post-deploy production attestation passes.

requiredGates.label: Google Owner completes live OFF → existing-session denial → ON recovery, with original tenant/department boundary and audit event retained
acceptanceCriteria: Owner authenticates through the production-bound Google identity.
Owner reads the target tenant status before mutation.
OFF immediately removes access for an already-issued staff session at the database/RLS boundary.
ON restores only the original tenant and department boundary.
All read, mutation, denial and recovery events are retained against the exact release commit.

requiredGates.label: Authenticated staging E2E passes for all 11 roles, negative cases, session lifecycle and synthetic journeys
acceptanceCriteria: Every configured role signs in and completes its permitted workflow.
Cross-department, disabled-account, expired-session and unauthorized-route denials pass.
Ten synthetic patient-to-payment journeys complete without real patient data.
Artifacts identify the exact release commit and isolated staging target.

requiredGates.label: Chananya/CNYOS and Jitarsa cross-tenant isolation passes at UI, API, RPC, RLS and database boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant A identities cannot enumerate, read, mutate or infer Tenant B records.
Service endpoints reject mismatched tenant identifiers and destinations.
Positive and negative tests cover UI, REST/RPC, RLS and direct database assertions.
Isolation evidence is retained for both tenant directions.

requiredGates.label: LINE OA signed callback, follow/unfollow, consent, revoke, QR issue/expiry/replay denial and manual HN fallback pass
acceptanceCriteria: Real signed callback verification passes with a dedicated synthetic LINE account.
Consent, link, revoke, follow and unfollow state transitions are auditable.
QR expiry and replay attempts fail closed.
Manual HN fallback completes without bypassing identity or consent controls.

requiredGates.label: Encrypted off-site backup is created, checksummed, downloadable and retained under the approved policy
acceptanceCriteria: A complete encrypted backup is generated from the release candidate environment.
Checksum and manifest validation pass before upload.
Authorized recovery staff can retrieve the backup without exposing application secrets.
Retention, rotation and deletion behavior are evidenced.

requiredGates.label: Backup restores into a fresh isolated target with reconciliation, integrity verification and measured RPO/RTO
acceptanceCriteria: Restore uses a fresh isolated database/project rather than the source environment.
Row counts, checksums and clinical transaction chains reconcile.
Measured RPO and RTO are recorded.
Failure, partial restore and cleanup behavior are documented.

requiredGates.label: Managed database backups and agreed PITR recovery level are enabled and recovery-tested separately from off-site export
acceptanceCriteria: Managed backup status and retention are verified in the database provider.
The agreed PITR or alternative recovery objective is documented.
A provider-level recovery test is completed independently from Google Drive export.
Evidence records recovery timestamp, target and reconciliation result.

requiredGates.label: Migration apply, failure, rollback/recovery and ledger reconciliation pass on production-like isolated staging
acceptanceCriteria: All required migrations apply in deterministic order.
A controlled failure demonstrates fail-safe recovery.
Rollback or forward-fix procedure is executed where supported.
Migration ledger and live schema reconcile with the exact release commit.

requiredGates.label: Error, uptime, security, backup, database, function and tenant-health monitoring alerts are active and delivery-tested
acceptanceCriteria: Minimum production telemetry covers application, functions, database, backups and tenant health.
Synthetic failures prove alert delivery to a named owner.
Alert thresholds, deduplication and escalation are documented.
A dashboard without tested alert delivery does not satisfy this gate.

requiredGates.label: SEV-1 tabletop proves containment, credential rotation, rollback, recovery, communication and reopening
acceptanceCriteria: Named incident roles execute the approved SEV-1 scenario.
Server-side containment and credential rotation are rehearsed.
Application rollback and database recovery decisions are tested separately.
Reopening criteria, timeline, decisions and post-incident actions are retained.

requiredGates.label: Independent application security assessment and penetration test close all production blockers
acceptanceCriteria: Reviewer is independent from the implementation author.
Scope covers authentication, session handling, authorization, tenant isolation, APIs, RLS, secrets and deployment surface.
Findings include severity, reproducibility and remediation evidence.
No unresolved Critical or High production blocker remains.

requiredGates.label: PDPA, DPA, privacy notice, retention, deletion, DSAR, breach response and DPO assessment are approved
acceptanceCriteria: Data inventory and record of processing are complete.
Controller/processor roles, DPA and subprocessors are approved.
Retention, deletion, DSAR and breach workflows are executable.
DPO and cross-border transfer assessments are documented where applicable.

requiredGates.label: Licensed practitioners approve knowledge, workflow, dosage safeguards, intended use and clinical limitations
acceptanceCriteria: Named licensed reviewers approve the knowledge version and workflow.
Dosage, allergy, contraindication and escalation safeguards are reviewed.
Intended use and non-automated clinical decision boundary are approved.
Correction, withdrawal and version-control procedures are documented.

requiredGates.label: Provisioning, billing, entitlement, SLA, support, upgrade, export and offboarding operate end to end
acceptanceCriteria: A tenant can be provisioned from approved commercial order data.
Billing and entitlement states reconcile with access control.
SLA, support, upgrade and rollback processes have named owners.
Customer export, termination, retention and offboarding complete without orphaned access.

requiredGates.label: Independent Quality SOP and producer-versus-approver segregation are verified
acceptanceCriteria: Production and Quality permissions are segregated.
The producer cannot self-approve or release the same batch.
Rejection, rework and release actions are auditable.
Quality evidence is reviewed independently.

requiredGates.label: Exact source/deploy provenance, required CI/review, protected main and protected production environment pass
acceptanceCriteria: Release source commit and tree match the deployed artifact.
Required CI and review checks pass for the exact commit.
Main/ release branch protection prevents unreviewed or failing changes.
Production environment protection and approval are independently verified.

postDeploymentGate.label: Exact production commit/tree, runtime surface, security headers and forbidden-path denial attested after deployment
